instruction: A floating heart built from chunky cubic voxels like a retro video-game pickup, a clear stair-stepped pixel silhouette in bright red with a lighter highlight voxel, gently oversized blocky charm.
user_instruction: Build a single-file three.js scene of ONE 3D pixel heart in a voxel pixel-art retro game style. A floating heart built from chunky cubic voxels like a retro video-game pickup, a clear stair-stepped pixel silhouette in bright red with a lighter highlight voxel, gently oversized blocky charm. Procedural three.js geometry, style-appropriate materials and lighting, orbit controls, single centered object.
